title: Chicken Thighs with Bacon and Mustard
author: Lorenzo
description: Chicken thighs wrapped in bacon and roasted with a honey-mustard glaze.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Mix the mustard and honey.
Brush the thighs with half the mustard mix, season with pepper and wrap each in bacon.
Lay them in an oiled dish with the garlic, rosemary and wine.
Roast for 35–40 minutes, brushing with the rest of the mustard halfway, until the bacon is crisp.
